scope: Added a record-backed NPC Session context loan and post-construction validator. No changes were made to the existing FSM source pair, root native test, build closure, or AndroidWorld bootstrap.

feature.ownership: Retains the exact canonical record, same source World lease, and existing host-context lease. It creates no actor, controller, target, FSM, Session, or timer store. The host-context owner is required not to retain the record, preventing an ownership cycle.
checks: provider world lease is the identical `record.services.world` object
record is a live NPC with the retained actor, object, controller, machine, FSM context, properties, and life
actor identity aliases its shared handle, object properties/life, and NativeFsm24 character/state
TargetBindings48.state and TargetOwner16 point to the same object target/owner, whose owner identity is this Character
record.services.controller and actor.controller project the same controller and Character identity
existing input aliases, if supplied, match the same properties/life/temp/target/FSM/host/level/object providers
the injected actual FSM event binder installs timer-expiry, command refresh/services, motion, animation, and gameplay providers
after script construction, Session timer owner and PropertyView sheets/resolved storage alias the same record
feature.timer_lifetime: The binder's TimerServices32 expiry callback belongs to the retained CampaignFsm and raises the same NativeFsm with the synchronous Timer32 pointer. CharacterScriptSession later creates its own actual TimerStore and native timer-growth wrapper; the helper does not allocate timers or retain stack-backed callbacks.
feature.provider_call_order: Use from CanonicalCharacterCandidateServicesV60::npc_script after the same-cache provider fills common/external/include byte spans and before RetainedCharacterActorV1::construct_script. The source renderer binds the existing FSM earlier through services.state. Validate the borrow immediately after construct_script creates actor.session.

required_external_providers.assets: Same ScriptAssetServices/cache and SkillTables lease, actual common and selected AI script bytes, include-file snapshot, and the same resolved AI row at properties.resolved[1].
required_external_providers.host: Strong host-context lease built from the same source World and Application, plus its HostContextBindings16 and actual LevelServices16 projections.
required_external_providers.controller: CanonicalCharacterCandidateServicesV60::controller projection and retained actor.controller, both for this actor identity.
required_external_providers.fsm_and_expiry: Already-bound sole CampaignFsmV101; caller injects bind_campaign_character_npc_events_v101, which owns command refresh/motion/animation/gameplay and TimerServices32 expiry.
required_external_providers.session: RetainedCharacterActorV1::construct_script creates the actual CharacterScriptSession; its own CharTimers storage must have this Character as owner.

fsm_bootstrap_audit.campaign_entry: bind_campaign_character_fsm_v101 is the Act1 path when the actual SourceCampaignCandidateBorrowV55 is available. It requires same record World, Application, actual sewn floors and CampaignNavigationRegistry.
fsm_bootstrap_audit.process_entry: bind_process_character_fsm_v121 preserves the sole CampaignFsmV101 owner and accepts a real process PF lease/geometry/registry, but leaves floors_ null. Existing Character.FindPath explicitly fails without actual sewn floors, so it must not be represented as Act1/campaign-complete.
fsm_bootstrap_audit.portable_backend_need: If the clean backend cannot provide an authentic SourceCampaignCandidateBorrowV55, the smallest same-owner extension is an additive FSM constructor/binder taking the actual Application, same-world lease, actual sewn floors, and same native ObstacleRegistry. It must initialize existing CampaignFsmV101 fields and once-only storage, never construct a second FSM. This extension was not implemented because the task restricted edits to the new NPC context feature/report.

validation.command: llvm-mingw clang++ -std=c++20 -Dfinite=_finite -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-unused-value -fsyntax-only with existing level-world/game-data/renderer dependency include paths and Box2D include path
validation.warnings: Clean with strict warnings; `-Wno-unused-value` suppresses legacy Box2D's existing unused-expression warnings.
validation.runtime: Not run. The current genuine Windows owner-factory test reaches actual LoadVisual and fails at the next real boundary, `Required actual NPC script cache/target/controller/timer inputs`; no initialized Session was published for this helper.
